$comment: Single source of truth for the promo soundtrack edit. Frames at 60 fps; sourceFrom = music time x 60. Grid of 樱落呼吸: 178 BPM, beat j at -0.01858 + j*60/178 s, bars start at j = 0 mod 4 (same indexing as scripts/build_sakura_breath.py). Segment 1 = beats 16-180 (intro, build, drop A); segment 2 = beats 484-504 + tail (last bar of drop C into the outro). Both splice points are downbeats of bar 29 of drops that share their arrangement, so the cut is near-seamless.
